definitions.explanation: A long pillow designed to be embraced while sleeping. In everyday use, it is a sleeping aid. In otaku culture, body pillow covers featuring anime or game characters are popular collectibles.

examples.japanese: {抱|だ}き{枕|まくら}がないと{眠|ねむ}れない。
examples.english: I can't sleep without a body pillow.

examples.japanese: {妊娠中|にんしんちゅう}は{抱|だ}き{枕|まくら}があると{楽|らく}だ。
examples.english: A body pillow is a comfort during pregnancy.

examples.japanese: アニメキャラの{抱|だ}き{枕|まくら}カバーがイベントで{販売|はんばい}されていた。
examples.english: Body pillow covers featuring anime characters were being sold at the event.

notes:
USAGE:
Has two main contexts of use. As a practical item, it is recommended for pregnant women, side sleepers, and anyone who finds comfort hugging something while sleeping. In otaku culture, {抱|だ}き{枕|まくら}カバー (body pillow covers) with printed characters are widely sold at anime events and online shops.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {抱|だ}き{枕|まくら}カバー (body pillow cover)
- {抱|だ}き{枕|まくら}を{抱|かか}えて{寝|ね}る (to sleep hugging a body pillow)
- {抱|だ}き{枕|まくら}{本体|ほんたい} (body pillow insert/inner)
